svg.title: Throttle across the request path
svg.desc: Caller -> ingress limits per caller and operation -> internal API pool limits -> egress fan-out caps -> dependency. The lower state-aware control uses latency, saturation and dependency health to adapt limits along the path. Its dashed arrow is a control signal, not another request hop. Enforcement is local; no remote accounting store is implied on every request's critical path. Throttling is not only a gateway concern.
